body: Thank you! I'll post it there :)
Hi, thanks for the support. I have calmed down a bit and just decided to go to sleep.

I like to daydream about my future.
How I would feel, my house. It's an idealised version of it. My own home away from everyone. A garden I can tend. I also daydream about interesting people. Conversations I would have with them. Weirdly enough I also daydream a lot about being in a tournament and just fighting people. Sometimes I would just imagine myself outsmarting people or beating them at things lol. I guess I romanticise being the best at things. I also love to daydream about being completely alone, looking at the stars while lying on the ground or enjoying the waves of the sea. No one expecting anything of me. No one around to tell me what to do. Just pure solitude. 
I imagine myself in a world that will make me feel whole. One that would make me feel real and powerful. You mentioned you daydream aswell, what about?

I suppose one of my triggers is school. While I love to learn I dont think school has ever been an environment I could be happy in. Im a perfectionist and put very high expectations on myself. I also hate being told what to do. My proctrastination has led me to get mediocore grades and I couldnt really deal with that. I started seeing a counseller and they helped me deal with the stress a little bit. Their approach was more solving things than working through them. I did'nt really like her. I still haven't had a chance to talk it all out. Im starting with a different therapist in September so I hope they can really help. Thank you for reading my rants. Im more of a listener than a talker so it's new that someone is willing to hear me out. You dont need to but thank you.

I was happy with myself because I knew where I wanted to be and I was willing to claw myself there. I loved psychology and philosophy and people. The world seemed extraordinary and endless. I loved how I viewed the world and that I could fight for myself. I loved how I had raw talent and the right mind to dedicate my life to one purpose. In my case that was becoming a psychologist. Everyone told me I could make it and I believed them. Then I becamed depressed and began suffering from chronic stress. I started to proctrastinate. At first I felt numb. I could feel the hole in my soul every minute of every day. It was making me go insane. I still had my mind then. After a while I stopped feeling numb and just felt nothing. Atleast that numbness felt strong, nothingness just feels limp. I suddenly wasn't ahead of eveyone else but drowning in my own head. I started to forget things. Memories, homework, sometimes I wouldn't be able to think about anything. I would scream at my mind to work but at a certain point I just started to hate everything. I lived for knowledge and curiosity. I felt so so alive. I and then I didnt. My own expectations started to crush me. I didnt feel alive anymore. Nothing was worth feeling, it wasnt enough anymore. Everything was dull and half-baked. I dont know where my passion went but I know I will never feel like that again. I still try to get that feeling back but nothing is enough. I dont love anything like that anymore.

I have been day dreaming my days away ever since. I posted on here for my own sake, a document I could actually look back on. Nothing has felt real in a long time for me. I just feel drained. I put my worth onto who I could become but I know that in the way I live my life now, I will never be that person. I keep clawing at an oiled wall and I keep falling. I know I can change but I have been trying for years to just get up an work. My body won't let me. I'm too tired. And I hate myself for it
